strictLayeredEvaluation.note: Local proof passed 4,494 tests with 162 declared skips, all 34 canonical main-evaluation courses, formatting, lint, release history, deterministic replay, the 446/138 ledger, strict 100-case source-only packet, corpus readiness, exact historical adapter lineage, proof smoke, production build, bundle budgets, and a Chromium changelog test. These prove compiler-contract recovery, campaign integrity, and software delivery readiness; they do not prove factual quality, educational preference, an adapter win, held-out performance, or paid-reference parity.

claims.summary: Twelve retained local Gemma projects replay exact historical response bytes through hash-bound compiler sources into derived projects with zero model-response mutation.
Conservative repairs recover sixteen source atoms, raising admission from 133/192 to 149/192 and reducing burden from 59/192 to 43/192 without claiming educational quality.
The neutral ledger byte-rebuilds to 446 cases, 138 source-grounded, while the historical captured projects and sealed campaigns remain immutable.
A fail-closed builder freezes exactly 100 source-grounded anonymous cases across four domains and twelve course groups without ungrounded filler or held-out overlap.
The corpus remains smoke-only at 76/418 usable rows and zero same-identity model-judge preferences; fresh isolated A/B and B/A passes remain mandatory before research training.
